stories.headline: Gypsy Rose Blanchard's fiancé Ken Urker dead at 33 - USA Today
stories.summary: Ken Urker, the father of Gypsy Rose Blanchard's child, has died at 34. Blanchard, in a statement, said Urker dealt with "relentless cyberbullying."

stories.headline: Why a new TV version of horror classic Carrie is already annoying people - BBC
stories.summary: Releasing next week, the latest take on Stephen King's novel has been criticised for its casting. The heroine is a softer, more conventional-looking character than in the book.
